subject: Portfolio Review – Lombard Facility and Portfolio Composition
body:
Dear Mr. Chandrasekaran,

I hope this message finds you well.

I would like to arrange a time to meet and review your portfolio together, covering a couple of items that merit our joint attention.

First, on the Lombard facility: the current loan-to-value ratio stands at 73.71%, against a trigger level of 75.00%, leaving 1.29 points of headroom.

Second, on portfolio composition: 68.4% of your wealth is currently concentrated in Singapore information technology holdings, represented by a single position and one instrument type.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss these points with you in more detail and to hear your perspective, so that we can consider together whether any adjustments would be worthwhile. Please let me know a convenient time for a call or meeting at your earliest opportunity.

Kind regards,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
